items.text: Exactly one person (Archie) is visible in the yard, and no one else is in frame.
Archie's face, hair, beard and clothes match the sprite master, with no changed hair colour, beard length or outfit.
Archie leans back against the brick wall on the right side of the yard, not centred and not on the left.
One of Archie's legs is bent with that foot flat against the wall, and the other leg is straight on the ground.
Archie looks relaxed: shoulders loose, no tense or defensive stance.
Archie's lips are pursed as if whistling, and he is not smiling or speaking.
Archie's eyes are directed toward the yard mouth, not at the camera and not at the bag.
A thin white plastic carrier bag with no visible logo hangs from one of Archie's fingers.
The corner of a flattened brown cardboard box shows through the bag.
Archie is mid-yard, a few metres from the camera, and is full-length or nearly so, at the same scale as the room.
The yard is the same as the blank plate: bricks, bins and other fixtures are unchanged, and the image size and camera angle match.
No car is visible anywhere, including at the yard mouth or its edges.
No buyers or other figures are visible, and the yard mouth is empty.
